A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ALEXR work and contain 52 pages, including Appendices A–H. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that differences are confined to pages 1, 10, and 16, with no material reading gaps.

before.justification: Section 9 reports original GDRO and partial AUC experiments, including test results in Tables 4–5. Appendix F supplies additional numerical analysis in Figure 3.

after.justification: Section 9 and Appendix F retain the original experiments, test results, and supplementary numerical analysis reported in v3.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 and its primal-dual updates are unchanged. The corrected prox-function formula in Section 4.1 agrees with the formula already present in the introduction and Appendix A; it does not introduce a different procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate GDRO on Adult and CelebA, and partial AUC maximization on Covtype, Cardiomegaly, Lung-mass, and Higgs. The tasks, group constructions, and tested scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 4 retains SGD, SGD-UW, OOA, BSGD, SOX, and SONX as GDRO comparators. Table 5 retains CE, OOA, BSGD, SOX, SONX, and SOTA for partial AUC.

E3.justification: Section 9 and Appendix F retain the same splits, preprocessing, linear models, evaluation metrics, iteration budgets, batch sizes, and parameter-tuning settings.

E4.justification: Appendix F.1.3 retains the group-size and dual-divergence analyses in Figure 3. Appendix H retains the theoretical ablation with extrapolation parameter θ = 0. No supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendices F.1.2 and F.2.2 still specify five runs with different random seeds. Tables 4–5 retain identical ± uncertainty reporting, with no revised statistical procedures.

E6.justification: All empirical results and curves are unchanged. For example, ALEXR's Adult accuracy at α = 0.1 remains 56.58 ± 0.69% in Table 4, and its Covtype pAUC at TPR ≥ 0.75 remains 0.605 ± 0.005 in Table 5.

T1.justification: Section 4.1 corrects f to ψ_i in the prox-function definition and deletes the blanket assertion Uψ(x,x′) ≤ D²_{ψ,X}. The remark following Theorem 6 changes the worst-case expression from n max_i D_{ψ_i,Y_i} to n max_i D²_{ψ_i,Y_i}. The theorem statements and appendix proofs are otherwise unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about ALEXR's single-loop design, convergence rates, optimality within the stated algorithm class, and applications.

C2.justification: The interpretations of convergence, dual-variable sparsity, empirical performance, and smoothness restrictions are unchanged. The mathematical corrections introduce no new substantive explanation or limitation.

D1.justification: Appendix F retains the same PyTorch implementation information, hardware, feature processing, hyperparameter grids, and sampling instructions. The supplied access links and their targets are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, Section 3 related-work discussion, Section 5.1 algorithm relationships, and Appendix G baseline analysis are identical.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp is updated, and localized mathematical text is corrected or deleted in Sections 4.1 and 6.2. The narrative, section order, and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The mathematical corrections slightly alter local formula typesetting and spacing on pages 10 and 16. All figures, tables, captions, and their placements remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The prox-function correction and restored square improve local mathematical consistency, while deleting the blanket bound removes an overstatement. The cleanup is incomplete: related diameter-bound expressions remain in Section 6.2 and Appendix D, whose proofs are unchanged. These corrections provide a limited improvement in precision without changing the empirical evidence.
